To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the relative impact of effective geometrical and material properties on modes of failures can be predicted through numerical modelling and the results can be used to predict the behaviour of retrofitted RC beams.
the relative impact of effective material and geometrical parameters on modes of failure in retrofitted RC beam can be predicted by using a simple but focussing numerical model.
“the relative influence of parameters, on beam behaviour and its critical location, can be used to predict the failure mode of a retrofitted RC beam”.
In summary, our research is concerned with
understanding the relative impact of parameters that can be used to explain premature failures of adhesively retrofitted RC beams.
understanding of relative behaviour of premature failures and its impact on the structural capacity of RC beam retrofitted with steel plate.
the relative behaviour of the premature failures in adhesion plated RC beam, using controllable and the existing parameters.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the relative impact of parameters can be used to predict the behaviour of a structure and its critical locations; which can further be used in the future to predict the behaviour and critical locations of retrofitted RC structures.
the relative influence of parameters on the modes of failures is a strong function of the relative beam capacities and brittleness.
the relative influence of parameters on modes of failure is a complex function of beam response and critical locations of beam.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

a large number of parameters can influence the premature failures in adhesion retrofitted RC beams, however, their relative impact on the overall response can be used to predict the cause of failure in a given structure or to predict the response of future retrofitted structures.

, a large number and range of parameters can influence the modes of failure in a retrofitted RC beam, however, the relative behaviour of these parameters can be used to identify the cause(s) and predict the future of such structures.
, the relative impact of parameters can be used as a tool for the evaluation of premature failures and the retrofitting of RC beam.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the relative impact of parameters is not only dependent upon the mode of failure, but is also dependent upon the location of the failure.
the relative behaviour of premature failure can be understood through the relative impact of parameters, which can be used for the re-evaluation and future prediction of retrofitted beams.
, the failure modes of retrofitted RC beams can be categorised in terms of the relative impact of parameters.
